items.headline: JMU ties NCAA record with 3 punt return TDs in 87-3 win
items.description: Michael Scott returned two punts for touchdowns and Miles Halbert blocked and returned another for a score as James Madison rolled past Wagner 87-3 on Saturday, tying the NCAA record for punt return TDs and setting a program record for points.

items.headline: James Madison begins the coach Billy Napier era with a 20-13 victory over in-state foe Liberty
